description: This file defines classes for data type operations related to complex data types (ArrayType, MapType, StructType) in pandas-on-Spark, including methods for comparison and type casting.

classes.name: ArrayOps
classes.description: Handles binary operations and type casting for pandas-on-Spark objects with ArrayType.

classes.name: MapOps
classes.description: Handles binary operations for pandas-on-Spark objects with MapType.

classes.name: StructOps
classes.description: Handles binary operations for pandas-on-Spark objects with StructType.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Concatenates two array-type pandas-on-Spark objects if types are compatible.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Performs less-than comparison for ArrayOps or StructOps.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Performs less-than-or-equal comparison for ArrayOps or StructOps.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Performs greater-than-or-equal comparison for ArrayOps or StructOps.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Performs greater-than comparison for ArrayOps or StructOps.

methods.name: astype
methods.description: Casts array data to a specified type, handling categorical, boolean, string, or other types.
